records.details: Home then Space selects only BITFB98.tmp checkbox, zero-byte item, other displayed checkboxes unchecked. Selection-only, no review/delete executed.
Second Space clears BITFB98.tmp checkbox; every visible row unchecked; no deletion.
CtrlTab exits grid and auto-scrolls Review and clean selected into view; summary Selected 0 item(s), 0 B proves restored selection. No activation/deletion.
